Third-party JavaScript libraries bundled with merpati-script
============================================================

Modifications: chai.js is patched in `addChainableMethod` (marked
"MERPATI PATCH") to reuse one prototype per assertion class for chainable
method wrappers instead of creating a new one on every property access. This
avoids a memory leak in the boa engine; behaviour is unchanged. All other
files are the unmodified upstream builds, with a one-line attribution
comment prepended where the upstream file had none.
